verdict.rationale: Publishing filing coverage and pricing up front is a fair question for a registered-agent and compliance-filing service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: www.wolterskluwer.com returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy CT host redirects into it. No CT Corporation page describing filings or states covered, or pricing, was retrieved, so there is no evidence the capability is delivered.
